note: Ranges from public, mostly vendor sources; ESTIMATES, not promises.

offers.offer: Call engine: site + Google profile + review requests + answer every review
offers.detail: Call engine: site + Google profile + review requests + answer every review (any local service)
offers.why: Compounds: more reviews, more map calls, rarely cancels. Tool cost $29-75/mo

offers.detail: Starter site + care plan (the 17% with no site, or a broken one)
offers.why: Easiest yes. Always attach the care plan

offers.detail: Missed-call text-back + booking link (plumbers, HVAC, roofers, detailers)
offers.why: Contractors lose jobs to voicemail. Business numbers only, replies to people who called

offers.detail: Accessibility + speed fix (door opener; any business with a site)
offers.why: The free report starts conversations. Say "common issues fixed", never "compliant"

offers.detail: Phone-scan 3D tour (wedding / event venues, gyms, studios, salons, Airbnbs)
offers.why: Free app + free web viewer vs Matterport crews. Get written permission to scan

offers.offer: Site on a subscription, no upfront
offers.detail: Site on a subscription, no upfront (owners who cannot pay $1,500 at once)
offers.why: Cash comes slowly; write the term and ownership into the contract

offers.detail: 3D product viewer for small makers (furniture, signs, sheds, jewelry, boats, bikes)
offers.why: `<model-viewer>` (free, AR on phones) instead of a $25K configurator

offers.detail: Before / after showcase (remodelers, landscapers, detailers, med-spas, dentists)
offers.why: Their phone photos become a slider gallery that sells; an add-on to #1 or #2

offers.detail: Shed / pergola / carport / trailer "configurator-lite" (options, live price, 3D preview, quote form)
offers.why: Vendors say leads double; most small builders still use a PDF price list

offers.detail: Virtual showroom for small dealers (used cars, RVs, boats, trailers: spins + one splat of the lot)
offers.why: Big dealers pay $300+/mo for software; small lots have nothing

offers.detail: Venue floor planner (banquet halls, wedding barns: drag tables, 3D view, send to the venue)
offers.why: Saves the venue site visits; pairs with #5

offers.detail: Service-area pages pack (one page per town + service for trades)
offers.why: Needs real, different content per page (no copy-paste spam)

offers.detail: Monthly "proof report" (calls, reviews, map views, site visits in plain $) for every retainer
offers.price: included; it is the anti-churn tool
offers.why: Clients cancel when they cannot see results

offers.detail: Rank-and-rent lead site (own a site for one high-ticket trade in one town, rent it)
offers.why: Slow and uncertain (Google may never rank it). Do it after 5 retainers

offers.detail: Custom immersive 3D brand site (scroll story, three.js)
offers.why: Great showcase, bad first business. Only with a fixed scope and 50% up front
